extracted.intended_audience: registered patent practitioners and counsel involved in USPTO enrollment and discipline matters
extracted.subtask_description: Administrative decision on a petition for reinstatement to practice before the USPTO, referencing the filing of a petition, an affidavit under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58, review of the record, and the Director's determination. Useful for understanding procedural and evidentiary elements considered in reinstatement proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition for Reinstatement (filing requirement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Consideration has been given to the Petition for Reinstatement of Sung I. Oh (Registration Number 45,583) received on July 8, 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A petition for reinstatement must be filed and received by the Office; the received date is recorded and forms the basis for consideration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: Mr. Oh has filed an Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 in support of the Petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filing an affidavit under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 is an explicit supporting submission for reinstatement petitions; compliance with this regulatory affidavit requirement is part of the record the Office reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review of petition, supporting affidavit, and all record information material to eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: After careful review of the Petition, the supporting affidavit, and all information in the record material to his eligibility for reinstatement, the Director ... has determined that reinstatement ... is appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Director considers the petition, any affidavits, and all other information in the record that is material to eligibility. This indicates a holistic review standard rather than reliance on a single document.

rubrics_metrics.name: Director's discretionary determination of appropriateness
rubrics_metrics.description: The Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline has determined that reinstatement of Mr. Oh to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office is appropriate. Accordingly, the Petition is hereby GRANTED.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Final authority to grant or deny reinstatement rests with the Director; the decision is stated succinctly as 'appropriate' or not and implemented by granting or denying the petition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification/Service of decision
rubrics_metrics.description: Copy to: Mr. Sung I. Oh [address].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Decisions are issued with copies provided to the petitioner (and presumably entered on the official record), demonstrating the procedural step of notifying the subject of the outcome.
